trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; vertex angle approximately 55 degrees with a vertical depth of approximately 10-15% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with frequent low-to-mid amplitude peaks; prominent macro-indentation (notch) located on the right lobe trailing edge approximately 1/3 the distance from the median notch to the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the leading edges, sweeping upwards from the peduncle connection to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity white pixels localized at the distal tips of both lobes and along the superior trailing edge of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent jagged indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe; high-contrast white formations at lobe tips.
